ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using Consent and Comctl32 - Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using consent.exe and comctl32.dll (UACMe 22)

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\consent\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\werfault\\\.exe$") AND (process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288"))
